full: 4735 passed in 141.38s with two workers (uncontrolled host conditions; not a paired whole-gate timing claim).

limits: The complete comparison uses actual collected pytest modules and counts compiler launches on each worker. An initial override imported a second copy of the module and did not change batch size; that invalid comparison is excluded.

Larger failing batches can require more diagnostic builds; successful batches build once.
